the presence of the pyridine ring and the hydrazonyl moiety is important for the cytotoxic activity of these compounds.

the 2‐hydrazone moiety plays a key role in the cytotoxicity of the target compounds.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the introduction of a 3‐hydroxy‐2‐pyridine moiety to pyrido[2, 3‐b] pyrazin‐3‐one core can improve the cytotoxicity of the resulting compounds against A549 cell lines.
the presence of the 2‐hydrazone group and the 3‐amino‐2‐pyridyl group in the pyridopyrazine core structure are important for cytotoxicity.
the presence of a hydrazonyl moiety on the pyrido[2, 3‐b] pyrazin‐3 (4H)‐ one scaffold is a promising pharmacophore for the development of novel anticancer agents.
